facts.fact: 重建一栋房子很难，重建一种生活难得多
facts.anchor: It is hard to rebuild a house. It is so much harder to rebuild a life.

facts.fact: 她在医院病床上醒来，浑身是伤，不记得自己怎么到那儿的
facts.anchor: I woke up, broken and bruised in a hospital bed. I didn’t remember getting there.

facts.fact: 她一度以为自己死了，这就是死后的人会遇到的事
facts.anchor: For a moment I thought I’d died and this was just what happened to folks after.

facts.fact: 床边小桌上有一盆系黄丝带的小仙人掌，旁边纸条写着"来自一个刺头的刺头，F x"
facts.anchor: Sat on the table was a small cactus with a yellow ribbon round the pot. Next to it was a note: A prickly bastard from a prickly bastard, F x

facts.fact: "只剩瓦砾了，"他说；Rowan 让他开车去看她，就在"你那次谈话"之后
facts.anchor: “Nothing but rubble left,” he said. “Rowan had me drive us round to check in on you after… your conversation.”

facts.fact: Rowan 告诉急救人员她提过一个邻居，于是他们去那栋满是违规搭建的隔壁找人
facts.anchor: “Rowan told the emergency services you’d talked about having a neighbour, so they went looking for her in the clusterfuck of building violations you call next door.

facts.fact: 他们说那地方看起来像荒废了好几年
facts.anchor: they said the place looked like it had been deserted for years.

facts.fact: 他们验了她身上的血，怕她杀了人；结果全是她自己的，于是给她起了外号"血浴"
facts.anchor: “But it’s all yours, so we’re calling you Blood Bath from now on.”

facts.fact: 她手臂上是一排针孔，红线不见了
facts.anchor: Along my arms, I saw the line of pinpricks from the needle. The red thread was gone.

facts.fact: "医生完全不知道那些是什么，"他说，还指望她能解答
facts.anchor: “Doctors don’t have clue what those are,” he said. “They were hoping you could enlighten them.”

facts.fact: "得了吧，我够男人，知道自己在犯浑。"他指着仙人掌："所以是'刺头'。"
facts.anchor: “Oh, come on. I’m man enough to know when I’ve been a prick.” He pointed at the cactus. “Hence the prickly bastard.”

facts.fact: "Ro 有捡流浪动物的习惯，"Fergus 说，又补一句"大概不该那么叫你"
facts.anchor: “See, Ro has a habit of picking up strays,” Fergus said, before adding, “Probably shouldn’t have called you that.”

facts.fact: "他知道把生活搞砸是什么滋味。我记得他刚搬来时，看上去像被什么缠着"
facts.anchor: “He knows what it’s like to fuck up your life. I remember when he first moved up here. He looked haunted.

facts.fact: "我以为你讨厌我是因为我来自城里之类的，"她说
facts.anchor: “I thought you hated me because I’m from the city or something,” I said.

facts.fact: "不，我评判你是因为你来自城里，"他带着一点笑，"但我不恨你。对不起让你有那种感觉。"
facts.anchor: “No, I judge you because you’re from the city,” he said, with a ghost of a smile. “But I don’t hate you. And I’m sorry I made you feel like that.”

facts.fact: "在这荒地方，我们只有彼此。要是连邻居都不能指望在你需要时出现，那——"
facts.anchor: “We’re all we have out here. If you can’t trust your neighbours to turn up when you need them, then—”

facts.fact: 手机弹出提醒："给 Rowan 发短信"
后来手机又弹出一条："喝水"。她喝了
facts.anchor: It said, DRINK WATER. I did.
